title: What Gratitude's Mechanics Actually Is (Most People Get It Wrong)
hook: Once you see this, you can't unsee it.
description:
Gratitude's Mechanics — explained in 60 seconds.

Gratitude is a memory-training protocol. It forces your brain to re-scan for what's working.

What actually happens in your brain: Your attention system filters ruthlessly. A gratitude practice literally reprograms what gets through the filter.

Try it today: Three specific things tonight — not 'family', but 'the way my sister called just to check in'. Specificity is the mechanism.

Mindforge posts one 60-second psychology explainer every day. Follow so tomorrow's video finds you.
